summary.text: Will Robinson Jr. represents District 71 in the Florida House of Representatives, first elected in 2018, according to the House's official biography.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists Robinson as a real estate attorney from Bradenton, born in Bradenton.
Robinson holds a B.A. in finance from the University of Notre Dame (1997) and a J.D. from Stetson University College of Law (2000).

sources.title: William Cloud "Will" Robinson Jr.'s official House profile
